journey.title: Finish setup with an optional gap
journey.purpose: Every required item is ready and one optional item is not. The operator continues deliberately, and the acknowledgement is recorded rather than forgotten.

steps.intent: See an optional item that is not ready, with its remediation.
Re-run the probe pass after attempting the fix.
Continue deliberately with the gap acknowledged.

claims.statement: Continue-with-degraded is unavailable while any required item is not ready.
The degraded acknowledgement survives a reload and remains visible to later diagnosis.
